basics.name: Zadkiel AHARONIAN
basics.label: Developer · Platform Engineer · SRE · Open Source
basics.summary: I build **developer platforms** for teams that need reliable Kubernetes, GitOps and delivery without turning product teams into platform experts. I have run **Kubernetes at scale** across public and sovereign clouds, on-prem and the edge. My work sits at the intersection of developer experience, reliability and open source, with **1,000+ merged upstream PRs**. I am now exploring how agentic AI reshapes platform engineering.

work.name: Airbus Aircraft
work.summary: Cloud-native and edge platforms for next-generation onboard aircraft systems.
highlights: Delivered **5+ MVPs** for next-generation onboard platforms, from concept to production-ready.
Designed **Kubernetes foundations** for onboard application management and rollout-constrained environments.
Built a Varnish-powered **onboard video distribution system** for content delivery.
Enabled **real-time computer vision** at the edge on Jetson/GPU hardware with optimized pipelines.
Built an AWS landing zone (Control Tower, AFT) with **self-service account vending**, and designed its dev-to-prod security gates.

work.name: CCL Consulting
work.summary: Kubernetes platform engineering and DevOps consulting across public and sovereign clouds.
highlights: Led development of a **self-service Kubernetes platform product** that provisions clusters and a complete, batteries-included app ecosystem from declarative config across local, cloud and bare-metal, with layered Helm/Kustomize composition and automated SBOM/dependency discovery.
Developed a **Kubernetes compliance engine** for real-time security and best-practice visibility across developers, compliance teams and operators.
Delivering platform maintenance and enhancements across client environments using immutable infrastructure, GitOps workflows and modern security practices to 10+ client teams.

work.name: Carrefour
work.summary: Internal Kubernetes platform team for Carrefour product teams, across GKE, Rancher RKE, Azure IaaS/Kubespray and AKS.
highlights: Operated and modernized 10+ Kubernetes clusters across multiple clouds, up to 200 nodes each, serving 50 product teams.
Led Kubespray to RKE and **RKE to AKS migration** with GitOps, immutable infrastructure and security guardrails, delivering high availability and zero-downtime cluster upgrades.
Built self-service Kubernetes platform capabilities, **GreenIT** resource-efficiency practices, runbooks, alert tuning and active on-call incident response.
Developed and contributed to Kubernetes controllers/operators for multi-tenancy, logging and platform automation.
